sprites.name: hero_body
sprites.description: The Exile (Witch, adult, 30s, sardonic). Base layer: pale skin #F0C8A8, dark hair, short dark witch hat #3A2A30 with a bent tip, and a cream/navy striped retro one-piece swimsuit (#E8E4DA / #2B3F6B) with modest scoop neck and boy-short legs, plus plain boots. 1 px ink #0A0809 outline, then a 1 px hero_rim #BDE6EE halo outside the ink on every outer edge (the hero's signature; no other entity uses it). Holds a short wand in the right hand. Head ~15 px tall, big readable expressions. Frame order (shared by every hero_* strip, 44 frames): 0-3 idle (breathing, 6 fps); 4-9 run (12 fps); 10-11 jump rise; 12-13 fall; 14-16 melee1 (antic, active slash, recover); 17-19 melee2 (antic, active backhand, recover); 20-23 melee3 (antic, antic-coil, active overhead, end-pose hold); 24-26 cast Spark (antic hand back, release palm-forward, recover); 27-31 dodge roll (crouch, tuck, tuck, tuck, rise); 32 hurt; 33-34 flustered (blush, sweat drop, eyes swirled; loop 8 fps); 35-36 swoon (knees wobble, hand to forehead); 37-40 dead (stagger, kneel, sit, flop on back fully clothed); 41-43 idle fidget (pulls out a scroll of trade whispers, reads, rolls eyes). Feet anchor: bottom-centre (24,63). Head top stays at y=2..4 except roll/dead. Faces right; code flips.

sprites.name: hero_leggings
sprites.description: Overlay: Lightning Leggings, yellow #F2D640 with a zigzag stripe, covering hips to ankles over the swimsuit. Transparent elsewhere. Ink outline; hero_rim on edges not touching hero_body pixels. Same 44-frame order and pixel registration as hero_body. Draw order: body, leggings, tunic, cloak, barrel, hat.

sprites.name: hero_tunic
sprites.description: Overlay: Cold Tunic, blue #58C6F2 long-sleeve tunic to mid-thigh with a frost hem, collar to neck. Ink outline; hero_rim on edges not touching hero_body pixels. Same 44-frame order and registration as hero_body.

sprites.name: hero_cloak
sprites.description: Overlay: Fire Cloak, red-orange #F0552E short shoulder cape with flame-tongue hem; lags the body 2-4 frames in run/jump/roll (follow-through baked). Ink outline; hero_rim on edges not touching hero_body pixels. Same 44-frame order and registration as hero_body.

sprites.name: hero_barrel
sprites.description: Overlay shown only at 0 layers: a wooden barrel #9A6234 with dark iron bands #5A3A22 and two rope shoulder straps, covering chest to knees over the swimsuit. The joke is that it covers nothing that needed covering. Bobs with the body; in roll frames the barrel rolls too. Ink outline + hero_rim on outer edges. Same 44-frame order as hero_body.

sprites.name: hero_hat
sprites.description: Overlay: cosmetic 'Supporter Pack' hat unlocked at stash 100: an absurdly tall gilded witch hat with a price tag dangling ('$480'). Replaces the base hat silhouette above the head; follows head position per frame. Same 44-frame order as hero_body.

sprites.name: hero_tabula
sprites.description: Tabula Rasa gag: a shapeless white linen sack (#E6E2D8, ink outline) with 6 sloppy stitched sockets and a paper price tag '1c' at the hip, sized to drape over the full outfit from shoulders to shins, arm holes only. Code bobs it 1 px with the run cycle for 10 s. Feet anchor (24,63).

sprites.name: grunt
sprites.description: Grunt archetype (L1 Thirsty Drowned look as the default): hunched angular humanoid, foe violet #9C7BE8 body, foe_dark #3E2A6A shading, spiky shoulders and a jagged jaw, glowing pale eyes #F4F7B0, ink outline, NO hero_rim. Triangular silhouette, wider at top. Frames: 0-1 idle; 2-5 walk; 6-7 swipe windup (arm raised high, 0.45 s tell pose); 8-9 swipe active; 10 hitstun; 11-13 dead (topples, fades to a little heap); 14-15 Wink Charm pose (hip cocked, one eye shut, finger-gun; code tints pink and shows ui_heart_tell). Feet anchor (20,47). Head top kept at y=4 (±1) so foe_hats anchors at (20,4).

sprites.name: caster
sprites.description: Caster archetype (default look Sand Spitter): thin robed floater, tall narrow inverted-triangle robe ending in a point (no feet), foe violet body, foe_dark hood, pale eyes, ink outline. Hovers (code bob 1 px at 2 Hz). Frames: 0-1 idle; 2-5 drift; 6-7 cast windup (hands cupped, white glow between them that code tints to the projectile element); 8-9 cast release; 10-11 Blown Kiss pose (hand to mouth, then flung outward; from L3); 12 hitstun; 13-15 dead (robe collapses empty). Origin anchor (20,47). Head top y=3 for foe_hats.

sprites.name: elite
sprites.description: Elite archetype (default Hillock's Wingman): broad brute, trapezoid torso with spiked pauldrons, small head, foe violet with foe_dark armour plates, ink outline. Smug grin. Frames: 0-1 idle; 2-5 walk; 6-7 shoulder-charge crouch tell (0.5 s); 8-9 charge dash (leaning, motion lines baked); 10-11 Pickup Line Charm pose (leaning on nothing, eyebrow raise, hand on chest); 12 recover; 13 hitstun; 14-16 dead. Feet anchor (28,55). Head top y=6 for foe_hats.

sprites.name: foe_hats
sprites.description: Per-level reskin accessory drawn at each enemy's head anchor (bottom-centre of this frame on the anchor, dy -1 on walk frames 3 and 5). Frame = (level-1)*3 + archetype (0 grunt, 1 caster, 2 elite). L1: seaweed tangle, sandy hood, sailor captain hat. L2: prison cap, warden's visor, sweatband + whistle. L3: templar chaperone bonnet-helm, choir collar ruff (adult baritone choirboy), inquisitor mitre. L4: stomach polyp nub, bile drip crown, cultist hood with a rose. L5: waiter bowtie headband, sommelier tastevin cup on chain, maitre d' slick hair + monocle. Colours from the level accent + ink outline; never pink, never hero_rim.

sprites.name: boss_hillock
sprites.description: Hillock, 'has waited 300 leagues': hulking stitched brute, original design (not GGG's): lumpy pale-violet hide, mismatched stitches, tiny heart-shaped patch on chest, big club. Lovesick puppy eyes. Frames: 0-3 idle (sways, sighs); 4-5 club windup (0.5 s); 6-7 club swing; 8-9 Hug Lunge tell (arms flung WIDE open, lips puckered, 0.6 s); 10-11 lunge (arms forward); 12 hurt; 13-15 defeated (sits, sniffles, hugs own club). Feet anchor (64,127).

sprites.name: boss_brutus
sprites.description: Brutus, gym bro in lockdown: enormous V-shaped torso, tiny legs (skipped leg day), headband, tank top, chains worn as gym jewellery, original design. Foe violet skin tone family with ink outline. Frames: 0-3 idle (bounces on toes); 4-6 flex tell (double-bicep, veins, 0.6 s); 7-8 slam (shockwave launch); 9-10 barbell toss windup (0.5 s); 11-12 toss release; 13-14 'Spot me?' shout (cupped hands, sweat flying); 15 hurt; 16-18 defeated (lies on a bench, thumbs up). Feet anchor (64,127).

sprites.name: boss_dominus
sprites.description: Dominus, the prude: tall gaunt templar in high-collared robes buttoned to the chin, gloves, scandalised expression, floats; carries a ledger of rules. Original design. Robe off-white with gold trim, ink outline. Frames: 0-3 idle (float, tut-tut finger wag); 4-6 Censor Volley cast (flings arm, tiny bars appear in hand); 7-8 Holy Pillar call (points down); 9-11 Purity Nova (arms crossed over chest, eyes shut, P2 only); 12 hurt (clutches pearls); 13-15 defeated (faints primly onto back, ledger falls open). Origin anchor (56,127).

sprites.name: boss_piety
sprites.description: Piety, 'not like other alchemists': adult woman alchemist, tall boots, full-length lab coat over a high-neck dress, goggles on forehead, satchel of flasks, smug pose. Original design. Frames: 0-3 idle (hair flip); 4-5 flask lob windup; 6-7 lob release; 8-9 wink Charm (0.5 s, finger to lips); 10 hurt; 11-13 defeated (dramatically swoons onto a crate, lab coat stays on). Feet anchor (32,79).

sprites.name: boss_heart
sprites.description: The Heart: a giant cartoon anatomical-ish heart (stylised, not gory) hung on fleshy cords, a single big cute-anxious eye in the middle, blush marks. Frames: 0-3 beat loop (doki-doki squash/stretch); 4-5 pulse swell tell (inflates 1.15x, veins glow telegraph orange, 0.6 s); 6 hurt; 7-9 defeated (deflates, flutters to the floor like a valentine). Origin anchor (64,127).

sprites.name: boss_kitava
sprites.description: Kitava, insatiable dinner date: towering ash-and-ember god (original design), huge jaw, horns, wearing a dinner bib/napkin tucked in, giant fork in one hand, knife in other. Charred grey-violet body with ember-orange cracks (ember accents use telegraph #FF8A3D only during tells). Frames: 0-3 idle (taps fork on table); 4-5 Fork Slam windup (0.7 s); 6-7 slam; 8-9 napkin tuck (Devour tell, 0.6 s); 10-11 Devour inhale (mouth wide, wind lines); 12-13 cheeks puff (Belch tell, 0.8 s); 14-15 belch; 16-18 Feast chomp (holds a tiny cloak/tunic/leggings to mouth, chews; code overlays fx_layer piece); 19 disappointed ('Nothing left to eat?', pouty); 20 hurt; 21-23 defeated (leans back, unbuttons nothing, pats belly, 'I'm stuffed'). Feet anchor (80,159). Strip is 3840 px wide; keep it.

sprites.name: proj_spark
sprites.description: Player Spark: crackling zigzag bolt in hero_rim #BDE6EE with a white-ish core (never loot_core), ink-free. Friendly read = hero colour. 4-frame flicker loop 12 fps. Never rotated: the zigzag reads in any direction, so code draws it unrotated and only flips x.

sprites.name: proj_bolt
sprites.description: Enemy elemental bolt: angular DIAMOND (never round, so it never reads as loot), drawn in white/light grey with a 1 px ink outline and a 2-px trailing spike; code multiplies a tint per element: phys #D8D0C0, fire #F0552E, cold #58C6F2, lightning #F2D640. Frames: 0-1 shimmer.

sprites.name: proj_kiss
sprites.description: Blown Kiss Charm projectile: pink #FF5FA2 heart with little cartoon lips in censor_text #2A0E1E, ink outline. 2-frame wobble.

sprites.name: proj_censor
sprites.description: Dominus's flying censor bar: perfect hard-edged rectangle, censor pink with a 4 px mosaic texture inside and tiny 'CENSORED' text in censor_text. Frames: 0-1 jitter 1 px.

sprites.name: proj_barbell
sprites.description: Brutus's barbell: bar with two plates, crackling lightning yellow sparks; 4 frames baked rotation (0, 45, 90, 135 degrees) since rotating pixel art is not allowed.

sprites.name: proj_flask
sprites.description: Piety's flask lob: round-bottom flask of fire-orange liquid with cork; 4 frames baked rotation 0/90/180/270.

sprites.name: proj_shockwave
sprites.description: Brutus Flex Shockwave: jagged triangular ground wave of phys-grey dust #D8D0C0 with ink outline, 24 px tall. Frames 0-2 crest roll. Code tiles nothing; one sprite travels.

sprites.name: hz_plate
sprites.description: Lightning floor plate (L2+): metal plate in bottom 8 px (ground tones, ground_rim top), zap arcs above. Frames: 0 armed (dull), 1-2 tell (small yellow sparks + telegraph-orange hatched edge, 0.6 s), 3 active (tall lightning-yellow zigzag arcs up to 24 px). Angular, never round.

sprites.name: hz_acid
sprites.description: Acid pool tile (L4, deals Fire): bile green #B6D84A surface with jagged toothy edges (angular), dark green depth, popping bubbles that release tiny fire-orange sparks so the Fire link reads. Seamless horizontally. 4-frame bubble loop 8 fps.

sprites.name: hz_fire_puddle
sprites.description: Piety's fire puddle: flat jagged flame decal in fire #F0552E with telegraph-orange tips, 3-frame flicker 10 fps. Seamless horizontally.

sprites.name: hz_tell_ground
sprites.description: Generic ground telegraph decal: telegraph #FF8A3D diagonal hatching on transparent with a 1 px pulsing outline; frames 0-1 scroll the hatching 1 px. Code tiles it horizontally to the AoE width. Used under Holy Pillar marks, Fork Slam, Hug Lunge path.

sprites.name: hz_pillar
sprites.description: Dominus Holy Pillar: a column of holy fire (fire #F0552E core, pale gold edges, ink-free), feet anchored to the ground. Frames: 0 thin start, 1 full, 2 fading.

sprites.name: checkpoint
sprites.description: Waypoint obelisk: angular stone pillar (ground tones, ground_rim edges) with a rune. Frames: 0 dormant, 1 active (rune glows hero_rim cyan). Feet anchor (12,55).

sprites.name: gate
sprites.description: Arena gate: rusty portcullis column. Frames: 0 locked (bars down, ground_rim highlights, small padlock), 1 half-raised, 2 open (raised mostly off-sprite).

sprites.name: orbs
sprites.description: World currency drops (original designs, perfect circles, each with one 2x2 loot_core #FFF4D6 highlight, ink outline). Frame order: 0 Chaos (white-gold swirl, loot_chaos #E6E2D8), 1 Tailor's Orb (pink loot_tailor #FF5FA2 orb with a needle-and-thread stitch), 2 Vaal (blood-red loot_vaal #E8423A orb with a hairline crack), 3 Exalted (pale blue loot_exalt #A8D8FF orb with tiny wings), 4 Divine (gold loot_divine #F2C14E orb with a halo), 5 Mirror of Kalandra (silver hand-mirror shape; never dropped, used only for the hideout pedestal).

sprites.name: pickup_tea
sprites.description: Cup of Tea pickup: round teacup on saucer, warm cream with pink rim, a tea bag tag. Frames: 0 cup, 1 cup with steam curl.

sprites.name: pickup_flask
sprites.description: Flask refill: small life flask (red liquid #E0384F inside glass, cork) on its side; ink outline.

sprites.name: prop_sign_dresscode
sprites.description: L1 sign on a post: 'LIONEYE'S WATCH - DRESS CODE STRICTLY ENFORCED' with a tiny pictogram of a crossed-out boot. Weathered wood, ink outline.

sprites.name: prop_chest_tabula
sprites.description: L1 beach chest. Frames: 0 closed, 1 open with a folded white sack visible inside.

sprites.name: npc_merveil_shell
sprites.description: L1 tide-pool seashell with a tiny fancy face and lipstick (original gag, not GGG art). Frames: 0 closed, 1 open singing (one music note).

sprites.name: npc_bestel
sprites.description: L1 bard NPC: friendly round-shouldered sailor with a lute, beard, rounded shapes (friendly = round). Frames: 0 idle, 1 talk.

sprites.name: prop_signup
sprites.description: L2 gym sign-up clipboard on a nail: every line reads 'Brutus' (scribble lines are fine at this size, top line legible).

sprites.name: prop_protein
sprites.description: L2 protein tub labelled 'WHEY OF THE EXILE'. Frames: 0 lidded, 1 lid off with a puff.

sprites.name: prop_tally
sprites.description: L2 cell-wall tally scratches with 'days since leg day:' and an infinity sign.

sprites.name: prop_window
sprites.description: L3 stained-glass window drawn entirely as a coarse 4 px block mosaic (the joke: even the window is censored), lead lines in ink.

sprites.name: prop_booth
sprites.description: L3 wooden confession booth with a curtain. Frames: 0 curtain closed, 1 curtain twitches.

sprites.name: npc_einhar
sprites.description: L3 beast-hunter cameo (original): wild-bearded hunter in furs with a net, sitting on a pew. Frames: 0 idle, 1 pointing excitedly.

sprites.name: npc_pigeon
sprites.description: L3 the 'GREAT prize': an ordinary grey pigeon. Frames: 0 idle, 1 head bob.

sprites.name: prop_vanity
sprites.description: L4 swallowed ornate vanity mirror (original design) showing 4 small reflections of the Exile. Frames: 0 idle, 1 shimmer, 2 reflection #3 winks, 3 shimmer.

sprites.name: prop_menu
sprites.description: L4 chalk menu board: 'TODAY'S SPECIAL: EXILE'.

sprites.name: prop_wetfloor
sprites.description: L4 yellow A-frame 'WET FLOOR' sign (the floor is wet).

sprites.name: prop_reservation
sprites.description: L5 reservation book on a lectern-top. Frames: 0 closed, 1 open ('Exile, party of 1, every league').

sprites.name: prop_tipjar
sprites.description: L5 tip jar. Frames: 0 empty, 1 one coin inside.

sprites.name: prop_dessert
sprites.description: L5 dessert cart with a silver cloche. Frames: 0 cloche down, 1 cloche lifted showing a single Tailor's Orb.

sprites.name: tiles_l1
sprites.description: Level 1 tileset, Twilight Strand: wet dark sand ground, driftwood, kelp, broken hulls; accent dawn teal #2E5E5C. Ground body #33291F family (lum <= 0.06), every walkable top carries a 2 px ground_rim #A08C66 edge. Frame order: 0 top-left, 1 top, 2 top-right, 3 fill-left, 4 fill, 5 fill-right, 6 one-way platform left, 7 platform mid, 8 platform right, 9-11 decoration (no collision, accent colour on <= 10% of pixels).

sprites.name: bg_l1_far
sprites.description: Level 1 far parallax (0.25x), Twilight Strand: wet dark sand ground, driftwood, kelp, broken hulls; accent dawn teal #2E5E5C. Sky/far layer from bg_far #0E1719 up to the level accent dark; lum <= 0.06 everywhere, saturation <= 40%, no outlines. Seamless left-right tiling.

sprites.name: bg_l1_mid
sprites.description: Level 1 mid parallax (0.5x): silhouettes of set dressing in bg_mid #1C2A2A tinted toward the accent, lum <= 0.06, no outlines, transparent above the skyline, seamless left-right.

Ground body #33291F family (lum <= 0.06), every walkable top carries a 2 px ground_rim #A08C66 edge. Frame order: 0 top-left, 1 top, 2 top-right, 3 fill-left, 4 fill, 5 fill-right, 6 one-way platform left, 7 platform mid, 8 platform right, 9-11 decoration (no collision, accent colour on <= 10% of pixels).

sprites.description: Level 4 tileset, Belly of the Beast: ribbed flesh floor (cartoon, not gory), cartilage ledges, wet sheen; accent flesh mauve #6E3448. Ground body #33291F family (lum <= 0.06), every walkable top carries a 2 px ground_rim #A08C66 edge. Frame order: 0 top-left, 1 top, 2 top-right, 3 fill-left, 4 fill, 5 fill-right, 6 one-way platform left, 7 platform mid, 8 platform right, 9-11 decoration (no collision, accent colour on <= 10% of pixels).

sprites.description: Level 4 far parallax (0.25x), Belly of the Beast: ribbed flesh floor (cartoon, not gory), cartilage ledges, wet sheen; accent flesh mauve #6E3448. Sky/far layer from bg_far #0E1719 up to the level accent dark; lum <= 0.06 everywhere, saturation <= 40%, no outlines. Seamless left-right tiling.

sprites.name: bg_l4_mid
sprites.description: Level 4 mid parallax (0.5x): silhouettes of set dressing in bg_mid #1C2A2A tinted toward the accent, lum <= 0.06, no outlines, transparent above the skyline, seamless left-right.

sprites.name: tiles_l5
sprites.description: Level 5 tileset, Kitava's Feast: long banquet-table planks, candle stubs, tablecloth ledges; accent wine #6A2430. Ground body #33291F family (lum <= 0.06), every walkable top carries a 2 px ground_rim #A08C66 edge. Frame order: 0 top-left, 1 top, 2 top-right, 3 fill-left, 4 fill, 5 fill-right, 6 one-way platform left, 7 platform mid, 8 platform right, 9-11 decoration (no collision, accent colour on <= 10% of pixels).

sprites.name: bg_l5_far
sprites.description: Level 5 far parallax (0.25x), Kitava's Feast: long banquet-table planks, candle stubs, tablecloth ledges; accent wine #6A2430. Sky/far layer from bg_far #0E1719 up to the level accent dark; lum <= 0.06 everywhere, saturation <= 40%, no outlines. Seamless left-right tiling.

sprites.name: bg_l5_mid
sprites.description: Level 5 mid parallax (0.5x): silhouettes of set dressing in bg_mid #1C2A2A tinted toward the accent, lum <= 0.06, no outlines, transparent above the skyline, seamless left-right.

sprites.name: bg_hideout
sprites.description: Hideout (between levels): cosy cave hideout with a crafting bench (left), a stash chest, a 'Standard League' banner and a tiny glass case on a pedestal at right-centre labelled 'MIRROR: 0' (empty). Floor top at y=300. Same lum <= 0.06 rule for the backdrop; furniture may reach 0.10.

sprites.name: ui_globe
sprites.description: HUD globe frames (40x40 liquid interior at offset (4,4), drawn by code as a rising fill). Frames: 0 Life globe frame (iron ring, ink), 1 Life frame with red #E0384F border (RES UNCAPPED), 2 Composure globe frame (ring with tiny teacup filigree), 3 glass highlight overlay (white crescent at 40% alpha, drawn last over both globes). Original design, not PoE's.

sprites.name: ui_globe_icon
sprites.description: Icons centred in the globes under the number: 0 heart (Life), 1 teacup (Composure). text colour #F3EAD8 with ink outline.

sprites.name: ui_pips
sprites.description: Resistance layer pips beside the Life globe. Frames: 0 Fire full (red-orange #F0552E with a flame glyph), 1 Cold full (#58C6F2 with snowflake), 2 Lightning full (#F2D640 with bolt), 3 empty socket (dark, ink ring), 4-9 crack-and-empty animation overlay (white cracks spreading, last frame matches empty). Glyphs make the element readable without colour.

sprites.name: ui_flask
sprites.description: Flask charge pip: 0 full (red liquid), 1 empty glass.

sprites.name: ui_bossbar
sprites.description: Boss bar frame: dark panel #15191B with ground_rim border and notched corners; code fills rect (2,2,256,10) in foe violet #9C7BE8. Boss name above in unique orange #E8913A text.

sprites.name: ui_panel
sprites.description: 9-slice panel (8 px corners): panel #15191B fill, 1 px ground_rim #A08C66 border, 2 px cut corners. Used for banners, whispers, death post, mod popup, hideout.

sprites.name: ui_bubble
sprites.description: 9-slice speech bubble (8 px corners): text-cream #F3EAD8 fill, ink 1 px border, rounded corners.

sprites.name: ui_bubble_tail
sprites.description: Speech bubble tail pointing down-left, same fill/border as ui_bubble; code flips.

sprites.name: ui_heart_tell
sprites.description: Charm tell heart above attacker: pink #FF5FA2 heart with ink outline and loot-free white glint. Frames: 0 normal, 1 swollen (pulses 8 fps).

sprites.name: ui_alert
sprites.description: '!' bubble over gag interactables on proximity: 0 normal, 1 bounce.

sprites.name: ui_mash
sprites.description: Mash glyph in a bubble over Flustered player: 0 'J' keycap up, 1 'J' pressed, 2 mouse left-button up, 3 pressed. Code alternates 0/1 or 2/3 at 10 fps by last input device.

sprites.name: ui_reticle
sprites.description: Mouse aim reticle for Spark: 0 ready (hero_rim cross with gap), 1 on cooldown (dimmed text_dim).

sprites.name: icon_currency
sprites.description: HUD/hideout currency icons, same order and colours as orbs: 0 Chaos, 1 Tailor, 2 Vaal, 3 Exalted, 4 Divine, 5 Mirror.

sprites.name: icon_portal
sprites.description: Portal life icon (oval swirl in hero_rim blue): 0 available, 1 used (grey outline).

sprites.name: ui_card
sprites.description: Patch Note card (hideout): parchment-on-panel look, header strip for 'PATCH x.y.z'. Frames: 0 normal, 1 focused (ground_rim border becomes text cream, 1 px lift shadow).

sprites.name: ui_button
sprites.description: Menu button: 0 normal, 1 focused. Panel style.

sprites.name: ui_weapon
sprites.description: Hideout weapon icon (a wand): 0 normal, 1 Corrupted (red cracks, red glow), 2 slam highlight (white glint).

sprites.name: ui_stamp
sprites.description: Rubber stamps: 0 'CORRUPTED' red stamp, 1 'REMOVED' pink stamp (mod popup). Slightly rotated look baked in.

sprites.name: ui_upvote
sprites.description: Fake-forum vote arrows (original, not reddit's logo): 0 up arrow orange, 1 down arrow blue-grey.

sprites.name: ui_modshield
sprites.description: Moderator shield icon for 'This post has been removed by the moderators. Rule 3.' popups: green-free, cream shield with a pink gavel.

sprites.name: ui_touch
sprites.description: Touch controls at 40% alpha (only after first touch). Frames: 0 stick base ring, 1 stick knob, 2 Jump, 3 A (melee), 4 B (Spark), 5 R (roll), 6 F (flask).

sprites.name: ui_pause
sprites.description: Pause icon (two bars) for touch, panel style.

sprites.name: ui_logo
sprites.description: Title logo 'PATH OF EX-ILES' in original chunky gothic pixel lettering, with a small pink heart replacing the hyphen and a censor bar over the word 'EX' captioned nothing (the bar itself is the joke). Not GGG's logo.

sprites.name: cut_door
sprites.description: Cutscene door (boss defeat card): heavy wooden door in a stone frame. Frames: 0 ajar with warm light, 1 closing, 2 slammed shut with dust puffs.

sprites.name: cut_pair
